remarks: RUSTIC ELEGANCE meets COZY SOPHISTICATION. Nestled on a PRIVATE ROAD in a highly COVETED LOCATION this 5,000 sqft home is an ENTERTAINER'S PARADISE. Sited on 1.28 landscaped acres, lush hydrangeas line sprawling stone walls. Bluestone patio with FP and built-in grill flow to outdoor dining, lively bocce court and firepit. CHARMING COTTAGE with wood deck rose trellis overlooks the 16X40 POOL and SPA. Indoors, luxury unfolds seamlessly across wide plank HWF's. GOURMET KITCHEN is a culinary masterpiece with Hemingway cabinetry, oversized island, and professional-grade Viking appls. Step down to vaulted family room w/ship lapped ceiling, custom FP and walls of windows. FORMAL DR with herringbone HWF's, coffered ceiling and romantic FP. Vaulted main-floor study makes working a dream. XL MUDROOM ensures ample storage for the entire family. STUNNING PRIMARY SUITE on 2nd fl with vaulted ceiling, FP, luxurious bath w/radiant floors and his/ her walk-in closets. 2 add'l BRs on this level boast their own baths. CATHEDRAL BONUS ROOM over garage offers 4th bedroom with en suite bath and kitchenette. The WALK-OUT LL IS A SHOWSTOPPER with half kitchen, full bath and glass doors that spill out onto private patio. Transform into in-law apt, au-pair, 5th BR, or fantastic home office. This LUXURY RESIDENCE is more than a home; it's a lifestyle. PERFECTLY SITUATED close to town, beach, and schools; yet a million miles away. Extensive home improvement list available.
